assumptions: Internal links initially target existing CMS detail routes because public permalink configuration does not exist yet.
Content checks warn but do not block saving.
The document outline and diagnostics use popovers/status controls so the existing editor width and page layout remain unchanged.
Image work is limited to confirmed gaps; existing width, alignment, alt, and caption controls are preserved.
replan_triggers: Repository state or requested scope changes.
A shared editor interface changes outside a task's declared boundary.
Validation reveals an incompatible Tiptap or Markdown round-trip behavior.
A task needs a new dependency or touches an undeclared feature area.
Two tasks contend for the same editor component.

tasks.objective: Provide tested pure utilities for heading outline, content diagnostics, safe link handling, internal target URLs, and paste cleanup.
expected_outputs: warning issues for duplicate headings, fragments, internal links, and image alt text
evidence_required: Passing unit tests for each check and sanitizer behavior
tasks.stop_condition: Utilities pass focused tests or an incompatible editor schema is documented.

tasks.objective: Replace prompt-based links with a reusable edit/internal-link popover and add outline and warning popovers without layout shift.
side_effects: Loads existing article and vault lists while the link picker is open.
expected_outputs: Create, edit, open, remove, and search internal links
evidence_required: Controls render as overlays rather than persistent columns
tasks.stop_condition: All controls work against one shared editor interface without changing page layout.

tasks.objective: Improve table affordances and close confirmed image-control gaps while preserving existing behavior.
expected_outputs: Clearer table controls and active states
Vault image insertion with meaningful alt/caption handling
evidence_required: Existing image presentation attributes survive replacement
tasks.stop_condition: Confirmed gaps are addressed without rebuilding existing controls.

tasks.objective: Add article-equivalent Markdown source mode to rich Vault items only.
tasks.stop_condition: Rich Vault items round-trip source edits and plain items remain unchanged.

tasks.objective: Validate all editor improvements together and obtain independent review.
side_effects: Runs local test and build commands.
expected_outputs: Biome, TypeScript, tests, and build results
validation: bunx biome check on touched files
tasks.stop_condition: All introduced failures are resolved and material review findings are handled.
